coarse_skill_concept: Diagnose and repair broken Python environments by resolving pip/setuptools failures, conda dependency conflicts, and package installation errors.

task_judgments.reason: Directly requires diagnosing why pip is broken on a system-wide installation and applying a targeted fix.
Core task is identifying and resolving conda version conflicts in environment.yml, which is exactly what the candidate skill describes.

The environment is not broken; the challenge is installing a complex scientific framework that requires apt-get system libraries (MPI, HDF5, FFTW, GSL) and a custom build script — a fundamentally different procedure from diagnosing broken pip or conda conflicts.

final_groups.skill_concept: Diagnose and repair broken Python environments by resolving pip/setuptools failures and conda dependency conflicts.
final_groups.reasoning: Both tasks start from a malfunctioning environment (broken pip, conflicting conda pins) and require the same diagnostic ladder: identify the failure mode, inspect interpreter/pip/dependency tree, apply a targeted fix, and verify installation succeeds.
